name: @dr.dsh/pwa
description: dr.dsh's remote client: a PWA that speaks to the daemon through the tunnel

scripts.build: rm -rf dist dist-worker && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npx tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && cp src/shell.js src/ws-bootstrap.js dist/ && cp static/index.html static/manifest.webmanifest static/icon-192.png static/icon-512.png static/icon-maskable-512.png static/favicon-16.png static/favicon-32.png static/apple-touch-icon.png static/logo.png static/logo-dark.png dist/
